reason: H0 exercises only the mesh simplification APIs and never reaches the voxel-remeshing code or varies its option flags. The change alters remeshing option-bit semantics and the option-dependent vertex-emission branch in emitVertex, leaving the implicated production surface entirely uncovered.
evidence: H0 calls meshopt_simplify, meshopt_simplifyWithAttributes, and meshopt_simplifyWithUpdate only; it contains no remeshing invocation.
In meshoptimizer.h, meshopt_RemeshSolve changes from 1 << 3 to 1 << 2 and meshopt_RemeshDebug is removed.
emitVertex changes its conditional from options & meshopt_RemeshDebug to options & meshopt_RemeshInternalDebug and changes the emitted coordinates in that branch to subtract 0.5f.
recommended_action: Add a dedicated remesher fuzz harness that derives remeshing inputs and option combinations from fuzzer bytes, including meshopt_RemeshThicken, meshopt_RemeshShell, meshopt_RemeshSolve, and mixed or unknown bits, and exercises vertex emission with boundary, thin-sheet, and degenerate voxel configurations.
